name: Subtitles
description: Clean subtitles timed to the voice: up to two lines at a time in the brand's text face, broken at pauses and sentence ends, on a dark box behind each line or with a shadow. Give a transcript with --words.

text.label: Text
text.description: what is said; leave empty to caption the transcript as it is. Wrap a word in *stars* for the accent
text.default: Most videos lose people in the first three seconds. Captions keep them watching.

accents.label: Accent words
accents.description: words to put in the accent wherever they are said, comma separated

ground.label: Behind the words
ground.description: box: a translucent box behind each line · solid: a near-opaque box · shadow: a soft shadow only

parts.words: the subtitle lines and their boxes
